message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• Exceeding by 5 mph or more is a misdemeanor.
• In construction zones, speed limits are reduced by 10 mph. | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn signals at least 100 ft before turning. | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of fire hydrants, driveways, or on sidewalks. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance. | | **Traffic Violations** | • Minor infractions (e.g., speeding) are typically misdemeanors.
• Serious violations (e.g., reckless driving) can lead to felony charges. | **Where to Find Official Rules** - Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - Texas Transportation Code – [https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/) - Texas Department of Public Safety – [https://www.dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov) Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
